title: React Foundations
description: Learn the basics of React, JSX, and state management.

subTopics.title: JSX & Rendering
subTopics.description: Learn the fundamentals of JSX and React rendering.

lessons.title: Intro to JSX
lessons.content: JSX is a syntax extension for JavaScript that allows you to write HTML-like code in your JavaScript files. It makes React components more readable and easier to write.

questions.question: What is JSX?
questions.explanation: JSX is a syntax extension for JavaScript that allows you to write HTML-like code in your JavaScript files.

subTopics.title: State Management
subTopics.description: Understand how to manage state in React applications.

lessons.title: State in React
lessons.content: State in React is a way to store data that can change over time. When state changes, React re-renders the component to reflect the new data.

lessons.title: Build a Counter
lessons.projectDescription: Create a simple counter component that increments and decrements a number using React state.

title: Introduction to Python
description: Start your Python journey with syntax, variables, and control flow.

subTopics.title: Syntax Basics
subTopics.description: Learn the fundamental syntax of Python programming.

lessons.title: Hello, Python!
lessons.content: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simplicity and readability. Let's start with the basics.

questions.question: How do you print 'Hello, World!' in Python?
questions.explanation: In Python, you use the print() function to output text to the console.

subTopics.title: Control Flow
subTopics.description: Master conditional statements and loops in Python.

lessons.title: If Statements
lessons.content: Conditional statements allow your program to make decisions based on certain conditions. In Python, you use if, elif, and else statements.

lessons.title: Guessing Game
lessons.projectDescription: Create a simple number guessing game using if statements and loops.

title: Introduction to Data Science
description: Learn the fundamentals of data science, from basic statistics to machine learning

subTopics.title: Getting Started
subTopics.description: Begin your data science journey with an overview of the field and essential tools.

lessons.title: Welcome to Data Science
lessons.content: Data science is an interdisciplinary field that uses scientific methods, processes, algorithms, and systems to extract knowledge and insights from structured and unstructured data.

questions.question: What is the main goal of data science?
options: To extract knowledge and insights from data
To store large amounts of data
questions.correctAnswer: To extract knowledge and insights from data
questions.explanation: Data science focuses on extracting meaningful insights and knowledge from data to inform decision-making.

lessons.title: Environment Setup
lessons.projectDescription: Set up your data science environment with Python, Jupyter notebooks, and essential libraries like pandas and numpy.

subTopics.title: Data Fundamentals
subTopics.description: Learn about different data types, collection methods, and basic data operations.

lessons.title: Data Types and Variables
lessons.content: Understanding different data types is crucial for data analysis. We'll explore numerical, categorical, and text data types.

lessons.title: Data Collection Methods
lessons.content: Learn about various methods for collecting data, including surveys, APIs, web scraping, and existing datasets.

questions.question: Which of the following is a categorical data type?
questions.explanation: Gender is categorical data as it represents distinct categories rather than numerical values.

lessons.title: Data Exploration Project
lessons.projectDescription: Explore a real dataset using pandas, examining data types, missing values, and basic statistics.

lessons.title: Data Cleaning Basics
lessons.content: Data cleaning is a crucial step in data science. Learn techniques for handling missing values, outliers, and inconsistent data.
